Package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface

Interface CosmeticCategory

public interface CosmeticCategory
A cosmetics category button in the cosmetics hub. Implemented by addons and registered with CosmeticsRegistry.register(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin, CosmeticCategory).
